description:
A security analyst needs to annotate key packets in an HTTP capture for an incident report. Open the HTTP capture file that is already loaded in Wireshark (from /home/ga/Documents/captures/http.cap) and perform the following:

1. Find the first HTTP GET request packet. You can use the display filter: http.request.method == "GET"
2. Right-click that packet and select 'Packet Comment...' (or use Edit > Packet Comment). Enter the comment exactly: Initial HTTP GET request to server
3. Find the first HTTP 200 OK response packet. You can use the display filter: http.response.code == 200
4. Add a packet comment to that packet with exactly: Server responded with 200 OK
5. Clear any display filter so all packets are visible
6. Save the annotated capture using File > Save As to: /home/ga/Documents/captures/http_annotated.pcapng
   Make sure the file format is pcapng (Wireshark/pcapng), as the pcap format does not support packet comments.

The output file must contain all 43 original packets with the two comments embedded on the correct packets.
